name: 72104 · Malvern, AR
findings: ZIP 72104 (Malvern) has 54 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 14 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 72104 (Malvern) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 72104 (Malvern) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 64% of the typical level).
